title: National Winner - ANUIES4MX Challenge
description: Selected from nearly 400 applicants as one of 25 national youth leaders in tech innovation. Designed and developed SmartWaste Vision during the challenge.
issuer: ANUIES (Asociación Nacional de Universidades e Instituciones de Educación Superior)

title: Emerging Technologies Fellow – International Program
description: Awarded a scholarship through the ANUIES4MX Challenge for top national performance, leading to a 3-month advanced training program in emerging technologies in Osaka, Japan. Co-developed the Flood Monitoring System during this fellowship.

title: 2nd Place - LoboHackathon 2024 (Converge Category)
description: Achieved second place leading the development of a Cybersecurity Incident Management System.
issuer: LoboHackathon Organizers (Benemérita Universidad Autónoma de Puebla - BUAP, likely)

title: Academic Excellence
description: Awarded for maintaining a perfect GPA of 10.0 / 10.0 during Bachelor's studies.
